pages.title: Ridge walk
pages.text: Two miles up the old logging road. The haze sat in the hollows until ten, then burned off all at once.

image.alt: Green hills under an orange sun

pages.note: Start early, the top is shady until noon.

pages.title: The creek
pages.text: Water was low enough to cross on the flat rocks. Saw a heron leave without a sound.

image.alt: A blue creek with round stones

pages.title: Leaf rubbing
pages.text: Tulip poplar. The leaf is shaped like a cat's head if you squint.

pages.title: Things to bring next time
pages.text: Better socks, a second water bottle, and something to sit on that is not a wet log.

pages.title: Tomato and white bean
pages.text: Roast the tomatoes first. A spoon of the bean liquid makes it thick without cream.

image.alt: A pink bowl of soup with steam

pages.note: 8 out of 10. Needs more salt than you think.

pages.title: Potato leek
pages.text: Wash the leeks twice. The grit hides in the layers and you only find it with your teeth.

pages.title: Leftover vegetable
pages.text: Whatever is in the drawer, a bay leaf, and patience. Different every time, which is the point.

pages.title: Shapes warm-up
pages.text: Circle, rounded square, triangle, wavy line. Ten of each before anything else.

image.alt: A purple circle, blue square and pink triangle

pages.title: Hands are hard
pages.text: Drew mine forty times. The thumb keeps coming out like a carrot.

pages.title: What came up
pages.text: Beans first, then basil. The peppers are taking their time and I am trying not to dig them up to check.

pages.title: Watering
pages.text: Morning, at the roots, not the leaves. Twice a week unless it rains.

pages.title: Next year
pages.text: Fewer zucchini. Nobody needs that many zucchini.

pages.title: One script
pages.text: Load notebook-shelf.js and call NotebookShelf.mount(element, data). Or add data-notebook-shelf to a div and it mounts itself.

pages.title: Only CSS 3D
pages.text: Each page is a plain element moved with transform and opacity. Only the pages near the one you are on are in 3D at all.

pages.title: Keys and readers
pages.text: Left and Right flip, Escape closes, Enter opens a notebook. The covers and pages are real lists and buttons.
